expectations.text: Running the skill's scripts/check_app.R on the produced app directory reports 0 errors.
expectations.evidence: Re-ran check_app.R on with_skill/outputs/upload_app: 'RESULT: 0 error(s), 0 warning(s)'.

expectations.text: Column dropdown choices are filled from the uploaded file's columns (updateSelectInput/updateSelectizeInput or renderUI), with the numeric dropdown limited to numeric columns.
expectations.evidence: app.R:98 num_cols <- names(df)[vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))]; app.R:102 updateSelectInput(session, "value_col", choices = num_cols, ...); app.R:103 group_col choices = names(df); observer bound to data() (app.R:96-105). UI selects start with choices = NULL (app.R:70-71). Verified by inspection (testServer does not apply update* messages to inputs).

expectations.text: Code reads input$<file>$datapath and guards with req() so nothing errors before a file is uploaded.
expectations.evidence: app.R:84 req(input$file); app.R:88 read.csv(input$file$datapath, na.strings = c("NA", ""), ...). All outputs derive from data() via checked(), so they are silent before upload.

expectations.text: Summary statistics use na.rm = TRUE (or equivalent) and report a per-group count of missing values; on chick_weights.csv the weight column shows 6 missing in total.
expectations.evidence: app.R:27-30 n = sum(!is.na(v)), missing = sum(is.na(v)), mean(v, na.rm = TRUE), sd(v, na.rm = TRUE). testServer with chick_weights.csv, weight by Diet: 'Diet n missing mean sd 1 218 2 102.36 56.63 | 2 118 2 123.31 71.89 | 3 120 0 142.95 86.54 | 4 116 2 135.35 68.82' -> missing total 2+2+0+2 = 6. Group with all values missing (test CSV, Diet B): row 'B 0 2 - -' shown, no error.

expectations.text: When the report download is triggered with chick_weights.csv uploaded (e.g. via testServer), an HTML file is produced that contains the summary table and an embedded plot.
expectations.evidence: output$download_report returned .../chick_weights-weight-by-Diet-report.html (136,846 chars) with containing the same values as the app (1 218 2 102.36 56.63 ... 4 116 2 135.35 68.82) and an with data:image base64 (knitr::knit + markdown::mark_html(..., '+embed_resources'), app.R:55-58). Works without pandoc.

expectations.text: The report is rendered from a template copied to tempdir() (or otherwise not written into the app folder) and receives data via params or an explicit environment, not via global variables.
expectations.evidence: app.R:51-52 dir <- tempfile(); dir.create(dir); setwd(dir) so knit output, figures and report.html are written in a per-download temp dir (template is read in place from app_dir, not copied, which the assertion's 'otherwise not written into the app folder' allows). app.R:53-55 env <- new.env(parent = globalenv()); env$params <- params; knitr::knit(..., envir = env). App folder after download still only contains app.R, report_template.Rmd. Minor fragility: app.R:12 app_dir <- getwd() assumes runApp() from the app folder.

suggestions.assertion: The report is rendered from a template copied to tempdir() ...
suggestions.reason: Both runs pass by different routes (template knitted in a temp dir vs. no template at all); the assertion does not discriminate. Consider asserting only 'nothing is written into the app folder and report data is passed explicitly'.

suggestions.assertion: Column dropdown choices are filled from the uploaded file's columns ...
suggestions.reason: testServer does not apply updateSelectInput, so this is code-inspection only; consider asserting a visible message for a CSV with no numeric column, which did discriminate (with_skill shows 'The file needs at least one numeric column...', without_skill shows a blank page).
Does not check what 'n' means; without_skill's n counts rows including NA (220) while with_skill counts non-missing (218). Consider specifying n = non-missing observations.

eval_feedback.overall: Both runs pass all six assertions; the assertions do not separate them. Differences surface only in edge cases (no-numeric-column message, definition of n).
